description: Returns how old these numbers are: the snapshot date, its age in days today (UTC), whether it is older than 7 days, the newest server first publish date and the newest spec change date in the data, and how the data is refreshed. Example output: {"snapshot_date":"2026-10-25","snapshot_age_days":4,"is_stale":false}. No arguments. Good for 'How fresh is this data?'.
name: data_freshness
